transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because the clinic got on me about how little I've been eating. But honestly, most days I'm just grabbing a coffee before my shift at the warehouse, and maybe a yogurt or a few bites of something after my GED class. Sitting down for a real meal just feels like... it throws off everything I'm trying to keep in line.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah, I am. I mean, if I eat something... like fried food from the break room at work, or a big plate at church, I get scared it’s going to show on me right away. I'll just keep thinking about it, and then I really want to go check the scale to make sure.
Are you currently underweight for your height?

Yeah, I guess I am. I mean, my work pants are pretty loose on me now, and people keep telling me I look too thin. But... honestly, when I see the number on the scale go down, I just feel like I'm finally getting somewhere. I really don't see why I should be pushed to put the weight back on.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time and feel like you can’t stop?

No, I don't really do that. I mean, like I said earlier, I mostly just stick to my coffee or a few bites of something small. Eating a whole bunch of food at once... no, I don't ever have that happen. I'm usually just trying to avoid eating too much in the first place, so doing that wouldn't make sense for me.
